independent_source_reconstruction: The original F01 global grid and L03 unique three-hole disk place Amber origin at J=(0,1); F03 fixes positive v north while F04 explicitly leaves two u signs. The frame transition carries both alternatives and does not silently choose a physical world.

L01/L02 name Amber local X; the selected inventory unit preserves originalLocalName X. Invented landmark-amber-X is absent as a complete source token and cannot become its localId merely by matching (-2,0).

The original source identity, quote, and clause-domain checks bind projected witnesses to F01/F03/F04/L03 or the landmark primary/support clauses. Physical counterpart and route-direction judgments remain in later NL modules.
typed_handoff_review: readFrames inventories original units, validates nonempty sourceFrame and complete local-name tokens, and delegates one current unit through advanceFrameUnit.iterateOn with pendingUnits.length as a decreasing measure.

advanceFrameUnit keeps prior completed results, refines support only for frame units, awaits the selected convention or landmark child, stores its actual nullable raw return, then projects source-bound alternatives/landmarks. Landmark units retain original support unchanged.

The step returns the actual shorter frontier with finish:true; readFrames gathers only accepted actual projections, preserving unresolved and failed units for repair without replaying earlier child work.

semantic_policy_location_audit.survey: Source reading and frame/landmark interpretation are numbered NL functions and scoped literals; exact clause parsing, name-token and quote membership are mechanics.
semantic_policy_location_audit.reconciliation: Physical anchor identity, optional pair compatibility and frame hypotheses remain NL modules assessAnchorPair, alignFrames and buildWorlds; v8 adds no TS helper for them.
semantic_policy_location_audit.planning: Available actions, sensor scope, all-world branch valuation and policy choice remain numbered NL modules including settleValue; arithmetic and finite state keys are exact mechanics.
semantic_policy_location_audit.audit: Per-world replay and challengeAssumption remain NL modules; the external verifyCandidate checks returned structure, source identity and bounded arithmetic only.
semantic_policy_location_audit.live_eval_js_displacement: unmeasured for v8; v7 teacher had case-specific coordinate checks and repeated convention judgments, so final row admission requires direct child-consumption inspection
